graphs-measurement-data-skill-01.target: I can use the key of a scaled picture graph, including half symbols, to find and compare amounts.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use the key of a scaled picture graph, including half symbols, to find and compare amounts.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting each picture as 1 instead of using the key. Try this: Circle the key and skip count by its value for each row.

graphs-measurement-data-skill-02.target: I can read a scaled bar graph, including bars that end between grid lines, and solve one- and two-step how many more and how many less problems.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read a scaled bar graph, including bars that end between grid lines, and solve one- and two-step how many more and how many less problems.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Reading a bar that ends halfway between lines as the lower line, or adding when the question asks how many more. Try this: Trace the top of the bar to the scale; find the value halfway between two labels.

graphs-measurement-data-skill-03.skill: Making Scaled Picture Graphs and Bar Graphs
graphs-measurement-data-skill-03.target: I can choose a scale and draw a scaled picture graph or bar graph that matches a data table.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can choose a scale and draw a scaled picture graph or bar graph that matches a data table.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Using a scale that does not fit the data, or drawing a picture for every single item. Try this: Divide each number by the scale; use half symbols or bars that end between lines when needed.

graphs-measurement-data-skill-04.skill: Measuring to the Nearest Half and Quarter Inch
graphs-measurement-data-skill-04.target: I can measure lengths to the nearest half inch and quarter inch with a ruler.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can measure lengths to the nearest half inch and quarter inch with a ruler.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Starting at 1 instead of 0, or counting tick marks instead of spaces. Try this: Line the object up at 0; find the whole inch, then count quarter-inch spaces past it.

graphs-measurement-data-skill-05.target: I can make a line plot of measurement data marked in whole numbers, halves, or fourths and answer questions about it.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can make a line plot of measurement data marked in whole numbers, halves, or fourths and answer questions about it.
graphs-measurement-data-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Leaving out values with no data, or placing a mark at the wrong fraction. Try this: Label every tick on the scale first; cross off each data value as you plot it.
